sources.title: Pinned Nemotron Mini 4B Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Names NVIDIA, exact model, Minitron-4B-Base fine-tune, English roleplay/RAG/function-calling training, text generation and 4,096 context. Body says32 attention heads; exact configuration and all stored tensors instead agree on 24. Current metadata names NVIDIA Open Model License while older body links Community license.

sources.title: Pinned Nemotron Mini configuration
sources.evidence: NemotronForCausalLM;32 dense decoder layers, hidden 3,072, intermediate 9,216,24 query heads,8 KV heads, head width 128, vocabulary 256,000, untied embeddings, ReLU2 and 4,096 maximum positions. BF16 and no quantization config.

sources.title: Complete PyTorch checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Original checkpoint is a single unquantized PyTorch ZIP archive, not safetensors. Bounded HTTP 206 reads obtained central directory and data.pkl metadata only (69,307 bytes of8,381,129,342-byte archive). Restricted metadata parser confirms 324 distinct contiguous BF16 tensor storages,4,190,509,056 learned elements; all names/shapes independently reconstructed from config and model code, and each ZIP storage size matches element count times 2. No weight payload downloaded.

sources.title: Transformers Nemotron implementation v4.44.2
sources.evidence: Compatible public module implementation: four biasless GQA projections, two biasless ReLU2 MLP matrices, two LayerNorm1P modules per decoder block with learned scale and bias, final LayerNorm and untied token embedding/output head. Rotary inverse frequencies are nonpersistent buffers. No routed experts, MTP or multimodal encoders. This is a compatible public release; checkpoint recorded 4.32.0.dev0 metadata is not represented as an obtainable exact source revision.

sources.title: Transformers Nemotron configuration v4.44.2
sources.evidence: Default attention_bias=false and mlp_bias=false; default head_dim=hidden_size/num_attention_heads=128; other dimensions derive from checkpoint config.

sources.title: Pinned chat and tool template
sources.evidence: Complete template emits System/User/Assistant/Tool roles and serializes tool definitions and contexts. No separate thinking toggle/channel is defined; that absence alone is not used to assert that the model cannot reason.

sources.title: August 20, 2024 NVIDIA Mini launch announcement
sources.evidence: Explicitly names Nemotron Mini 4B Instruct and says the model is available as a NIM for cloud and on-device deployment. Earlier than baselineAugust 21 and later HF distribution; establishes earliest documented release found.

sources.title: August 20, 2024 technical launch and deployment article
sources.evidence: Card-linked launch article uses historical Nemotron-4 4B Instruct name and says NIM is available. Describes instruction tuning, distillation/pruning and function calling; INT4 reference is on-device package, not the unquantized BF16 HF checkpoint counted here.

sources.title: NVIDIA February 14, 2025 license metadata update
sources.evidence: Owner commit explicitly changes license_name from nvidia-community-model-license to nvidia-open-model-license and replaces license_link with the June 2024 Open Model agreement. Body Community link remains unchanged; root LICENSE is empty. Chronology supports current intended Open Model license rather than treating old body PDF as newest declaration.

sources.title: NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement, June 14, 2024
sources.evidence: Agreement directly linked by updated exact-model metadata; title and version date verified. Model and derivative-model usage/distribution are governed by its conditions.

sources.title: Official checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Repository createdSeptember 10,2024; initial model uploadSeptember 11; metadata license changedFebruary 14,2025. HF distribution occurs after August 20 NIM launch and is not substituted as earliest model release.

sources.title: Compact Language Models via Pruning and Knowledge Distillation
sources.evidence: Card-linked NVIDIA report describes Minitron ancestry and instruction tuning. Table 5 lists the base architecture32 layers / 3,072 hidden / 24 heads / 8 query groups / 9,216 MLP and 4.19B. This corroborates architectural reconstruction, but no unsupported sibling active count or reasoning mode is transferred.

sources.title: NVIDIA Build exact-model page access check
sources.evidence: Browser text extraction and a fresh direct HTML request returned only the application shell, not the model card. No factual capability claim is taken from this unavailable body.

sources.title: Fresh official repository revision and model-card check
sources.evidence: October 27 recheck returns revision 791833e92ebddb0bc2c1007f6d2b6764f886a2ae, the same revision as the prior bounded checkpoint audit. Fresh complete README and config reads retain the exact Minitron-4B-Base fine-tune relationship and the same BF16 architecture dimensions. No active-parameter figure is declared. No checkpoint or tensor census was rerun.

sources.title: Exact Minitron-4B-Base model card
sources.evidence: Freshly read exact named base card: Minitron-4B-Base is obtained by pruning Nemotron-4 15B embedding width, attention heads and MLP width, then continued training with distillation. This is the explicitly named base of Nemotron Mini, not an unmodified 15B model or a Llama-3.1-Minitron 4B variant. The card supplies no separate active count.

sources.title: LLM Pruning and Distillation in Practice: The Minitron Approach, Tables 1 and 2
sources.evidence: Later original NVIDIA tables explicitly list the previous-generation Minitron 4B at 4.2B Total Params and 2.6B Non-Emb. Params, including its aligned comparison. These are total and non-embedding counts, not active counts. The separately identified Llama-3.1-Minitron-4B depth/width models are 4.5B and do not describe the exact named base here.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report active-parameter comparison check
sources.evidence: Freshly checked original report and small-model comparison tables, including Table 7 with explicitly labeled Activated Params. Its entries include Gemma-3-4B and Qwen models, but full-text search finds neither Minitron nor Nemotron. No active count can be transferred from these other dense models.

sources.title: OLMoE: Open Mixture-of-Experts Language Models, Table 4 active-parameter comparison check
sources.publisher: Allen Institute for AI authors / arXiv
sources.evidence: Freshly checked original Table 4 and the report text: Active params is an explicit comparison column, but it does not list Minitron-4B or Nemotron Mini. No Minitron match appears in the full text; the Nemotron reference concerns Nemotron-4 340B, a different model. This supplies search coverage, not an active count for the present model.

sources.title: Watt Counts, Table 11 and Section 5.2
sources.publisher: Mauricio Fadel Argerich, Jonathan Fürst and Marta Patiño-Martínez / arXiv
sources.evidence: Original HTML and PDF Table 11 identify nvidia/Nemotron-Mini-4B-Instruct as dense, with 4.000B total and 4.000B active, evaluated on 10 GPUs. Section 5.2 states the authors’ dense total-equals-active convention. The nominal 4B row is compatible with the independently verified architecture and size; padded decimals do not establish exactness. Unrelated table errors prevent wholesale adoption.

name.note: Readable exact-model name retained. Historical launch also calls it Nemotron-4 4B Instruct; current official identity is Mini.

developer.note: Exact card identifies NVIDIA as model developer.

family.note: Nemotron family and Nemotron decoder architecture; Minitron is its explicitly named base, not a different developer.

release_date.note: Contemporary August 20 primary announcement explicitly states availability as NIM. August 21 follow-up and September HF repository publication are later distribution/publicity dates.

open_weights.note: Public unauthenticated access to original BF16 checkpoint metadata succeeded; official downloadable weights exist.

license.note: Current exact-model owner update replaces Community license metadata with Open Model agreement. Stale Community body/PDF and empty root LICENSE are recorded; no claim that a blank LICENSE is governing text.

parameters_b.note: Retain the prior complete checkpoint count of 4,190,509,056 learned parameters across 324 BF16 tensors, including both untied embeddings and LayerNorm biases. The fresh official API check confirms the same pinned revision, and fresh card/config reads corroborate its identity and dimensions; no new tensor census was performed. Original Minitron Table 5 reports 4.19B with matching architecture, and the later NVIDIA comparison reports nominal 4.2B for the explicitly named Minitron-4B base. These rounded disclosures corroborate, rather than replace, the existing precise total. Watt Counts uses nominal 4B; retain the more precise existing total.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 4B active from the exact-checkpoint Watt Counts Table 11, under its authors’ stated convention. This is an original research comparison, not an NVIDIA active-count disclosure or an independent per-token tensor measurement. The precise total remains 4.190509056B. Neither the 2.6B non-embedding count nor another Minitron variant is substituted.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive Transformer:32 decoder blocks,24 query heads and8 KV heads, ReLU2 two-matrix MLP and LayerNorm1P. Card prose 32-head claim conflicts with config and weights; reconstruction uses 24 verified heads.

context_window.note: Exact config maximum 4,096 and card explicitly states 4,096 tokens. Baseline 128,000 has no support in these exact-model sources.

modalities.note: Text-generation model with token embedding / LM head and no visual/audio components. Speech and animation in ACE are separate models, not Mini modalities.

reasoning.note: Exact model is documented for roleplay, RAG and function calling; no explicit dedicated reasoning mode assertion or explicit model-wide denial located. Full template has no thinking controls, but absence does not verify false; clear baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact card explicitly says function-calling fine-tuning and supplies tool-call prompt format; tokenizer serializes tools and tool responses.

description.value: Dense Transformer fine-tuned from Minitron-4B-Base for English roleplay, retrieval-augmented question answering and function calling.
description.note: Concrete supported lineage and tasks; removes unsupported efficient-reasoning/agent marketing.

patch.notes: The BF16 checkpoint has 4.190509056B learned parameters, consistent with NVIDIA’s nominal 4.19B Minitron base specification. Active 4B follows the Watt Counts authors’ nominal benchmark convention, not an NVIDIA disclosure or exact per-token count. Context is 4,096 tokens. August 20, 2024 marks documented NIM availability; Hugging Face distribution followed in September. NVIDIA changed the model license metadata to the Open Model License in February 2025; the card body retains an older Community license link.

checkpoint_audit.method: Read only eight bounded HTTP 206 ranges for ZIP directories and pickle tensor metadata; restricted find_class allows only OrderedDict, dummy storage descriptors and a metadata-only tensor builder. No torch.load or imported remote code. Independently generate all 324 expected names/shapes from pinned config plus compatible public constructors, check contiguous strides/zero offsets, unique storage IDs and every ZIP storage byte count.

summary: Retain the verified 4.190509056B total and establish nominal 4B active from Watt Counts’ exact-model comparison. Other 12 field assessments and prior checkpoint audit remain unchanged. No new tensor census or weight download was performed.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain precise total; replace the earlier unresolved active assessment with an attributed nominal research count.
parameter_reaudit.reopened_for: Bounded review of the newly identified original Watt Counts comparison; the earlier primary-source search is retained above.
parameter_reaudit.fresh_evidence_check: Reopened the original arXiv HTML, read the supplied original full text, and independently inspected the PDF Table 11 rendering. Compared the exact checkpoint identity, architecture and nominal size with the earlier source readings and checkpoint evidence. No broad search or checkpoint reconstruction was repeated.
parameter_reaudit.source_quality_assessment: The source is an original inference study with exact repository IDs. Its neighboring Llama-3.1-Minitron-4B-Width-Base row is a different model, and its 5B value conflicts with the earlier NVIDIA report’s 4.5B. Some MoE rows are also mislabeled dense. Acceptance is limited to the independently corroborated Nemotron Mini identity and nominal size; those errors remain a limitation of this source.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Exact token-dependent participation and an NVIDIA-specific active-count definition remain unestablished.
